_comment: Q-PAC Total Fan System DVT — stub. Super-system level: MPF + Fan Controller + Panels + Site integration. Sibling MPF and Fan Controller DVTs cover their respective sub-systems.

meta.title: DESIGN VERIFICATION TEST
meta.subtitle: Super-system verification — MPF + Fan Controller + Control Panels + site integration
meta.descriptor: Total-system DVT. Sub-system qualification is in sibling DVTs.
meta.creator: Systems Engineering

coverRows.label: Unit Under Test (UUT)
coverRows.value: Q-PAC Total Fan System — MPF assembly + installed Fan Controller + control panels + site interconnect

coverRows.label: Test Bench
coverRows.value: Total-system test bench or representative site mock-up

coverRows.label: Release Gate
coverRows.value: Section severity → required sections per Appendix B. Sibling Fan Controller DVT and MPF DVT must pass on the units installed in the UUT before TFS DVT begins.

coverRows.label: Sibling Documents
coverRows.value: Q-PAC Fan Controller DVT (controller-side); Q-PAC MPF DVT (motorized impeller frame); Premium Panel scenarios doc

coverRows.label: Format
coverRows.value: Contents page (clickable TOC) immediately after cover. Sections — table-based per-test rows. Tester records measurement in Measure column. Field refresh (Word: Ctrl+A → F9; LibreOffice: Tools → Update → Fields) updates page numbers and TOC P/F mirror. Elaborations in Appendix C. Equipment in Appendix A. Release-gate matrix in Appendix B.

knownIssues.heading: Known Issues
knownIssues.intro: System-level xfail entries and corresponding DVT step pass criteria.

externalRefs.title: Fan Controller DVT
externalRefs.intro: Controller-side qualification is owned by the Q-PAC Fan Controller DVT. The TFS DVT treats the installed Fan Controller as a qualified sub-system.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed Fan Controller DVT on record for the controller serial installed in this TFS.

externalRefs.title: MPF DVT
externalRefs.intro: MPF-side qualification is owned by the Q-PAC MPF DVT. The TFS DVT treats the installed MPF as a qualified sub-system.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed MPF DVT on record for the MPF serial installed in this TFS.

appendixA.heading: Appendix A — Equipment
appendixA.intro: All test equipment, fixtures, and instrumentation referenced from test rows.

appendixB.heading: Appendix B — Release-Gate Matrix
appendixB.intro: Change severity mapping to required DVT sections. Refine with stakeholders before treated as authoritative.

appendixC.heading: Appendix C — Elaborations and Rationale
appendixC.intro: Design rationale and known-issue mechanisms referenced by Brief column.

sections.name: Total System Assembly
sections.intro: Verify the complete assembly with MPF, Fan Controller, and panels integrated.

sections.name: Interconnect and Wiring
sections.intro: Verify site-side wiring, terminations, and signal continuity end-to-end.

sections.name: Panel Integration Scenarios
sections.intro: End-to-end Premium and Basic control panel scenarios. Operator workflow.

sections.name: Operational Scenarios
sections.intro: Full operational scenarios under representative site loads and BMS commands.

steps.brief: Verify all sub-assemblies installed per drawing; SNs recorded; sibling DVT artifacts attached.
steps.criteria: All SNs recorded; [fc_dvt] and [mpf_dvt] artifacts attached

steps.brief: Verify site-side wiring to BMS / supply / panels per drawing.
steps.criteria: All connections per drawing; zero crossed pairs; insulation intact

steps.brief: Run Premium Panel scenarios end-to-end with operator at panel and BMS connected.
steps.criteria: Each scenario produces documented system behavior; operator UX matches spec

steps.brief: Operate system at representative duty cycle for 1 h. Log all telemetry.
steps.criteria: System tracks BMS commands; airflow per spec; no unexpected alarms; logs complete

steps.brief: Run system continuously for 24 h. Log everything.
steps.criteria: Zero drift; zero unexpected faults; rails and currents stable; logs complete

elaborations.text: Both [fc_dvt] and [mpf_dvt] must pass on the actual units installed in the TFS UUT before TFS DVT begins. TFS does not duplicate sub-system coverage; it exercises only emergent system-level behavior.

equipment.name: Site-mock BMS
equipment.spec: Per site spec or representative simulator

categories.name: Sub-system change (FC or MPF)
categories.required: Section A or B re-signed + full [ops] + [runlife]

categories.name: Combined system release
categories.required: Sections A and B re-signed + full DVT (C through G)
